title: Wire the two reachable shell suites by named file; keep the test-only atrium-contract suite out

scope.judgedWhole: Every test file in the directory is a row. Once two of three run, the directory is PARTIAL and leaves the dark-directory ratchet's set, so that ratchet can no longer see a fourth file added beside them. The control pins the directory's on-disk file set to this record in its place.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with `npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci` on the base: 3 of 3 green (6, 9 and 1 cases).

wiring.step: Run the T-784 shell suites by named file
wiring.whyByFile: Naming the directory would also select atrium-contract.test.ts, whose subject is listed testOnly in docs/architecture/orphaned-lib-modules.json. Retire-or-mount for that module is the gated half of T-784.

gatedHalf.decision: Retire src/lib/shell/atrium-contract.ts and src/lib/sentinel/tense-guard-allowlist.ts with their suites, or mount each from a product path.
gatedHalf.status: decision needed — not taken by this record
gatedHalf.heldHere: src/lib/shell/__tests__/atrium-contract.test.ts. The sentinel module's suite sits in a directory T-783 also holds and is not in this record's scope.

Its subject src/lib/shell/atrium-contract.ts is listed testOnly in docs/architecture/orphaned-lib-modules.json. T-784's gated half owns retire-or-mount.

forbiddenEdits: No suite file in the directory was edited, and neither test-only module was touched.

suites.rationale: Green 6 of 6, but its subject is reached only by this suite. Held for T-784's retire-or-mount decision.
